abilities.name: synchronize
abilities.effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

abilities.name: magic-guard
abilities.effect: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

kanto.flavorText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close.

original-johto.flavorText: When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha parti­ cles come out of the surface of its body.

hoenn.flavorText: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into KADABRA while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong ha waves that can ruin precision devices.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.

updated-johto.flavorText: If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.

original-unova.flavorText: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.

updated-unova.flavorText: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.

kalos.flavorText: If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Kadabra holds a silver spoon in its hand. The spoon is used to amplify the alpha waves in its brain. Without the spoon, the Pokémon is said to be limited to half the usual amount of its telekinetic powers.

original-alola.flavorText: Kadabra’s presence infests televisions and monitors with creepy shadows that bring bad luck.

updated-alola.flavorText: It possesses strong mental capabilities, but its psychic powers are halved when it’s not holding a silver spoon.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backward.

swsh.flavorText: This Pokémon’s telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

pla.flavorText: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.
